About Gnasher's Grimoire

A free companion for the Dungeon Master. One file, runs offline, no account, no server. Your books stay yours.

Version

Gnasher's Grimoire™ · Version ? · © 2026 Long Island Dungeon Master. 'Gnasher's Grimoire', 'Adventure Keepers', and the .keeper format are marks of Long Island Dungeon Master.

Get more books at longislanddungeonmaster.com/keepers. Players use Gnasher's Satchel, its free companion, at longislanddungeonmaster.com/satchel.

What stays on your computer

Everything. Your books, notes, tables, saves and PDFs live in this browser, and nothing leaves it on its own. The one exception is the live table: same-room pairing works with no internet at all; the standard pairing code goes through a small LIDM relay so your players can find your table, and when two networks cannot reach each other directly the encrypted link may pass through public STUN or TURN servers. What you push (maps, handouts, rolls) rides that link and nothing else does. Back the binder up with Export .keeper, or keep it on a USB drive with Binder on a drive.

Your PDFs are stored in this browser only and are not included in .keeper backups or the Drive Binder, so keep the PDF files themselves too.

At the table

Want the map on a TV? Open the Satchel in the TV's browser, make a character called Screen, join your table with it, and the players' view of the board fills the screen, fog and all. Your laptop stays the DM's screen.

Press N for the notebook. Type what just happened; find it later by pressing Space and typing any word of it. Notes ride the Chronicle and your .keeper backup.

Something broken?

Report a problem. The app writes up the technical details, you read every word of it, and you send it yourself. The app never sends anything on its own.

🐛 Report a problem

Something broken, confusing, or just wrong? Tell me what happened and the Grimoire will write up the technical details for you.

What gets sent — read it, it is the whole report

The Grimoire never sends this anywhere. There is no telemetry and no reporting service; you copy or send it yourself. Everything the app added is counts and status — no book text, no character names, no table code, no whispers, no notes. Your description is included exactly as you type it, so leave out anything you would not want to share. (“Email it” hands the report to your own mail app, which may be webmail. If a table is open, the Grimoire keeps talking to the code service for pairing, as it always does — that is unrelated to this report.)

Paste it wherever suits you: frank@longislanddungeonmaster.com. Bugs, wishes and “this bit made no sense” are all equally welcome.

How the Theater works
1. Link the table. Tap Open the table by code and read the code aloud (something like EMBER-42). Each player types it into their Satchel (the wax seal, top left) and taps Join. No internet at the venue? Tap Same room first, or share your phone's hotspot; the + Invite by paste button trades the link as copied text instead.
2. Run the fight. Nothing extra to do: your combat tracker drives every paired Satchel. Each player sees the order, and a YOUR TURN banner when it's them.
3. Handouts. Title, text or image, Push text or Push image. Pick a name in the To row to whisper it to one player alone; everyone else never sees it.
4. Resting seats. A player's phone dozing off shows their seat as resting. Keep playing; whatever you push is held and delivered the moment their screen wakes. Their Satchel rejoins by itself.
5. The code sticks. A saved table keeps the same code, so your players type it once and it still works next week. Reload this page mid-session and the table reopens on its own, seats and all, with nobody typing anything. Only Change the code makes them retype.
Players start at longislanddungeonmaster.com/satchel.
